title: Normalized integral support functors and their restricted adjunctions
statement:
Fix the global datum $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme, $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion and $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ its complementary open immersion [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Put $A_n=R/t^n$ for $n\ge1$, $B_T=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_T$ on the small pro-etale site of $T=X,U,Z$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $\mathcal C_T=D^b_c(T,R)$ for the full derived-complete integral constructible subcategory of $D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_T))$, with uniformly bounded constructible finite reductions [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed].

Use ordinary module operations over $B_T$ [def-sf-proetale-ring-sheaf-operations]. Identify the specified integral pullbacks $i_R^*,j_R^*$ with ordinary inverse image by the projection- and shift-compatible comparisons of [lem-sf-integral-immersion-pullback-normalization]. Let $J_R$ be the specified integral compact-support operation for $j$, using the compactification $(j,\mathrm{id}_X)$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and let $I_R$ be the specified integral direct image for $i$ [def-weil-derived-direct-image]. Thus their strict finite towers are respectively $(\operatorname{Res}_n j_!N_n)_n$ and $(\operatorname{Res}_n Ri_{*,n}M_n)_n$, with quotient-induced transitions; $N_n,M_n$ denote derived reductions and $\operatorname{Res}_n$ restriction along $B_T\to(A_n)_T$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction].

There are canonical natural isomorphisms of derived-category-valued functors
$$J_R\xrightarrow{d_j}j_!^{\mathrm{ord}}|_{\mathcal C_U},\qquad I_R\xrightarrow{d_i}i_*^{\mathrm{ord}}|_{\mathcal C_Z}.$$
The first is the comparison from strict system realization using the actual reduction/total-limit unit and the open reduction isomorphism. The second is inverse to the canonical direct-image/strict-limit comparison on quotient towers; termwise $i_*$ commutes with $\operatorname{Res}_n$. Both respect shifts and finite projections. Ordinary open extension and closed direct image preserve completeness; their finite reductions are $j_!N_n$ and $i_*M_n$, constructible in the same uniform integer cohomological interval as the inputs. Consequently $J_R,I_R$ are exact $R$-linear functors into $\mathcal C_X$, with the termwise shift comparisons.

The ordinary derived adjunctions restrict under these comparisons to
$$J_R\dashv j_R^*,\qquad i_R^*\dashv I_R$$
on the full integral constructible categories. Their units and counits are the ordinary termwise derived units and counits under the specified comparisons; on the open side these agree with the strict-system-realized adjunction maps. For every $M\in\mathcal C_Z$ the natural composite $j_R^*I_RM$ is zero. These conclusions concern the specified functors and maps, rather than an unspecified isomorphism of their object values.

proof.text: Use [lem-sf-integral-immersion-pullback-normalization] to obtain Noetherian X,U,Z and quasi-compact j. Define the base structures on U and Z by composition. Finite-type and quasi-compact composition supply their structure-map properties. The base prime-unit lemma [lem-weil-structure-direct-images-constructible] maps along each residue-field algebra map and supplies the required inverse instances.

Apply [lem-sf-open-support-normalization] and [lem-sf-closed-support-normalization]. Their clauses are strictly separate open and closed comparison arguments. The isomorphisms dj and di transport the already constructible outputs of the actual support functors to the ordinary images, using isomorphism closure [lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated].

The closed ordinary pull map is invertible on constructible inputs by completeness; invert its whiskering with the full inclusion to form closedPull. Restrict the ordinary derived closed adjunction along the two fully faithful inclusions, with closedPull inverse and di inverse. Apply [lem-sp-fully-faithful-adjunction-restriction]: its component formulas and inverse/hom cancellation prove closedUnit and closedCounit. The open lemma fixes its adjunction to that same restriction; the same two formulas prove openUnit and openCounit. Copy the remaining separate comparison, projection, shift, exactness, scalar and zero-composite clauses into Normalization. The actual compact-support linearity theorem sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor_linear and directImage_linear of [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization] supply scalar linearity without new obligations.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q17-4181fe553 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item in full, all 20 proof-dependency statements, the main-20261015 parent proof (integral-stage and rational-stage paragraphs) and the Stacks tags cited (0A07 and 04C4 read). The statement is unchanged, the split has 7 steps and no new nodes, and there is no repair note, so the re-split rule does not apply. The steps are sound and the hypotheses hold. (R,(t)) fits the adic datum: R is Noetherian, R/t is a finite field (torsion) and [R --t^n--> R] gives perfect quotients. j is quasi-compact. l is invertible on X, U and Z. A closed immersion is qcqs. (j,id_X) is a valid compactification, since def-weil-compactifications-refinements does not require density. The formula for d_j and its unit/counit identification come exactly from lem-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison. On the closed side, the strict tower agrees with def-weil-derived-direct-image because Res_n commutes with i_*. The directions b and c in the fully-faithful restriction are correct. The shift and linearity steps are honest degreewise and naturality arguments, and no finite Tor amplitude is used. The dependency closure contains no cycle, there is no duplicate node (det-sf-open-closed-extension-zero-limits is a different statement), and no SGA source is cited. Edge cases checked: Z empty, U empty, n=1, nonreduced Z, zero input, arbitrary shift. Two faults repaired. (C1/C4) Step 3 applied prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits, whose completeness is the Koszul condition, to objects whose completeness is the quotient-tower condition of def-weil-derived-complete. It did not cite the equivalence. I added prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction (c_K o kappa_K = comp_K) to Step 3's text and uses, to proof_deps and to split_report.tool_uses. (E5) In Step 4, the passage from R^q i_* G = 0 for constructible sheaves to H^r(Ri_*G_n) = i_* H^r(G_n) was a bare 'consequently'. The truncation-triangle induction is now written out. I accept the declared generic tool_uses. Fix file: fixes/dag/nodes/sec-smooth-purity/lem-sf-integral-support-functor-normalization.json.; 1 file(s) fixed by the reviewer
